newsitem.title: BELGIUM: SCHOELLER-BLECKMANN TO LIST ON EASDAQ.
newsitem.headline: SCHOELLER-BLECKMANN TO LIST ON EASDAQ.

text.p: Austrian engineering company Schoeller-Bleckmann Oilfield Equipment AG will start trade on Brussels-based small cap market Easdaq on June 20, making it the market's ninth issue, an Easdaq spokeswoman said on Monday.

Five hundred thousand Schoeller-Bleckmann shares, or 31 percent of the company's outstanding share capital, are being sold through a private placement to investors in Europe and the U.S. 125,000 shares being sold are presently held by Austria's Berndorf group. The remainder is new shares.
The issue is due to be priced today, Easdaq said.
The issue is being lead managed by Investment Bank, Austria. Co-manager is French Banque Paribas.
Schoeller-Bleckmann will trade on Easdaq in Austrian schillings, making it the second Easdaq issue along with French Chemunix to trade in its national currency.
